caption: The video captures a close-up, stationary view of a compression-testing rig in operation. A large polished cylindrical steel platen presses downward onto a horizontal stack of pale wooden sticks bound together in clear plastic film. The stack rests on a cylindrical base painted with diagonal yellow-and-black hazard stripes, set against a flat pale grey-green machine frame, with a matching striped guide rail fixed at the left edge. Throughout the excerpt the base, frame, and left rail hold their positions, confirming the camera does not move. The steel platen descends steadily relative to the static base, its lower edge sinking toward the uppermost stick. Under this pressure the wrapped stack shortens visibly, its overall height shrinking as the platen continues its slow downward travel. A splintered stick end protrudes more prominently at the upper-right side of the stack as the compression proceeds. The clear plastic wrap creases and shifts slightly around the binding but stays in place.
relations: The striped base, frame, and left rail remain fixed while the platen descends toward the stack.
As the platen lowers, the wrapped wooden stack compresses vertically between platen and base.
The upper-right splintered stick end protrudes more as stack height shrinks.
Clear plastic film creases and shifts slightly but stays wrapped around the sticks.
